auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Enter your school board email address. We’ll send you a 6-digit code.
auth.codeHelp: The email can take a minute to arrive. Check your junk folder too.
auth.invalidCode: This code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.unknownEmail: If this address has access to the app, a code was just sent to it.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.confirmIntro: Press the button to sign in on this device.
auth.confirmFailed: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new code.
auth.noAccess: Your account doesn’t have access to a school yet. Contact your principal or the support team.

errors.title: Oops, something went wrong.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission to do that.
errors.inUse: Not possible: this is used somewhere else.
errors.invalid: Some of the information isn’t valid.
errors.featureDisabled: This feature isn’t turned on for your school.
errors.unexpected: Something unexpected happened. Your changes weren’t lost: please try again.
errors.network: Connection lost. Your changes weren’t lost: please try again.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
errors.notAName: Enter a first name or nickname only.
errors.alertsKeyMissing: Alerts aren’t configured on this server. Contact the support team.
errors.pageNotFound: This page doesn’t exist or you don’t have access to it.
errors.tooLongForLevels: This text is too long for this many levels. Shorten it or choose fewer levels.
errors.aiDisabled: AI is not turned on for your school. The principal can turn it on from the School page.
errors.aiBudgetReached: Your school has reached its AI limit for this month. Contact your principal.
errors.aiBusy: Too many requests in progress or in the last hour. Wait a little, then try again.
errors.personalInfo: The text contains personal information. Remove it before sending.
errors.aiUnavailable: The AI service is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.aiConfig: The AI service is not set up correctly. Contact the support team.
errors.aiRateLimited: The AI service is very busy. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.aiRefused: The AI could not process this text. Try rewording it.
errors.aiTooLong: The text is too long to process at once. Try a shorter text.
errors.invalidOutput: The AI’s answer was not usable. Try again.
errors.aiError: Something went wrong with the AI service. Try again.
errors.timeout: The request took too long. Try again.
errors.levelInUse: This level is still used by a recent request or a saved text. Uncheck “Active” to hide it instead.

today.title: Today
today.unknownCycle: The cycle day isn’t set for this date yet. Ask the principal or the office to set up the cycle.
today.noClasses: You don’t have a class yet.
today.noBlocks: Nothing on your schedule that day.
today.noActiveUnit: No unit in progress for this subject.
today.unitFinished: Every lesson in this unit has been taught.
today.lessonUnmarked: The lesson is no longer marked as taught.
today.gapWarning: An earlier lesson in this unit wasn’t checked off: “{title}”.

classes.title: My classes
classes.empty: You don’t have a class yet.
classes.emptyHelp: Create your class to add your students, timetable and units.
classes.name: Class name
classes.gradesHint: Choose several grades for a combined class.
classes.studentCount: {count, plural, =0 {no students} one {# student} other {# students}}
classes.teamHelp: People on the team see the class’s students, timetable and planning.
classes.deleteHelp: Students, alerts, the timetable, units and lesson tracking will be permanently deleted. To confirm, type the class name.

students.title: Students
students.privacy: To protect students’ privacy, the app keeps only a first name or nickname. Never enter a last name, birthdate or student number.
students.pasteHint: You can paste a list. If two students have the same first name, add a marker, for example “Liam 2”.
students.csvHelp: The file is read on your device. Only the column you choose is sent.
students.preview: Preview ({count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}})
students.importButton: Add {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}
students.added: {count, plural, one {# student added} other {# students added}}.
students.blockedRows: Rows marked in red won’t be added.
students.defaultLevelHint: Used to group students and choose the right version of activities. It is not an official assessment.
students.deleteConfirm: Delete {name} and all their data? This can’t be undone.

alerts.title: Safety or medical alert
alerts.help: Short text, visible only to the class team, the principal and that day’s substitute teacher. Every view is logged.
alerts.textHint: For example: severe peanut allergy, EpiPen in backpack.
alerts.disabled: Alerts aren’t turned on for your school.
alerts.unreadable: This alert can’t be decrypted. Contact the support team.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.emptyHelp: Add the week’s periods: subjects, routines, breaks.
timetable.daysHint: Check every day this period happens.
timetable.subject: Subject
timetable.blockTitleHint: For example: Morning prayer and O Canada
timetable.overlap: Heads up: this period overlaps another period on the same day.

units.title: Planning
units.intro: Each subject has one unit in progress. The next lesson that isn’t checked off shows up in Today.
units.subject: Subject
units.deleteConfirm: Delete the unit “{title}” and all its lessons?

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.subNotesHint: Where to find materials, students to watch, special instructions.
lessons.expectationsHint: Link the lesson to Ontario curriculum expectations.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: PA days, holidays, masses, assemblies and early dismissals. The day’s schedule takes them into account.
calendar.timesHint: Leave empty for the whole day. Early dismissal: enter only the dismissal time. Late start: only the start time.

school.title: School settings
school.anchorsHelp: Say which cycle day falls on a date. Weekends, PA days and holidays don’t move the cycle forward. Add a marker to restart the cycle.
school.alertsHelp: Turn on only after the school board approves. Every view is logged.
school.alertsEnabled: Turn on alerts for this school
school.aiIntro: Lets staff prepare differentiated texts with AI (Claude, by Anthropic).
school.aiPrivacy: Before anything is sent, student and staff names are replaced with markers, and any request that contains personal information is blocked. Only the de-identified text is processed by the AI provider, possibly outside Canada. Everything that is stored stays in Canada.
school.aiStatusOff: AI is off: no text is sent.
school.aiEnableConfirm: Turn on AI for {school}? Staff will be able to send de-identified text to the AI provider.
school.aiRequests: {count, plural, =0 {No requests} one {# request} other {# requests}}
school.aiOnlyDirection: Only the principal or vice-principal can turn AI on or off.
school.aiBoardOff: Your school board has not allowed AI for its schools. Contact the board to discuss it.
school.aiStatusBoardOff: AI is turned off by the school board: no text is sent.

profile.title: Profile
profile.honorificHint: Used in substitute plans, for example “Ms.” or “Mr.”.
profile.languageHint: What you type (lessons, names, events) stays as is.

differentiate.title: Differentiated text
differentiate.intro: Paste a text, instructions or an activity. The AI prepares a version for each French level, with the same learning goal.
differentiate.aiOffNotice: AI is not turned on for this school. The principal can turn it on from the School page.
differentiate.textHint: Up to about three pages for two levels, less for more levels. Don’t paste personal information: emails, numbers, addresses or birth dates.
differentiate.objectiveHint: Optional. Otherwise the AI finds it in the text.
differentiate.subject: Subject
differentiate.previewTitle: What will be sent to the AI
differentiate.previewIntro: Student and staff names are replaced with markers. The real names are put back only once the answer is back on our servers, in Canada.
differentiate.replacedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No names replaced.} one {# name replaced.} other {# names replaced.}}
differentiate.previewCheck: Make sure no other personal information (for example a parent’s name) is left in the text.
differentiate.blockedIntro: Remove these from the text, then check again:
differentiate.recentHint: Requests are deleted after 30 days. Save the results you want to keep.
differentiate.working: The AI is preparing your versions. This usually takes less than a minute.
differentiate.workingHint: You can leave this page: the result will be in your recent requests.
differentiate.failed: The request could not be completed.
differentiate.glossaryHint: One word per line, as “word: definition”.
differentiate.deleteSavedConfirm: Delete this text and all its versions? This cannot be undone.
differentiate.discardConfirm: Remove this request from the list? Its result will be deleted.
differentiate.aiNotice: Prepared with AI. Review and adjust it before using it in class.
differentiate.aiBoardOffNotice: Your school board has not allowed AI: your principal can’t turn it on.
differentiate.failedDraftRestored: Your last request didn’t go through: its text was restored.
differentiate.resumed: The text of your earlier request is filled in. Check it, then send it again.
differentiate.failedKept: Your text isn’t lost: reuse it to send it again, as is or edited.
differentiate.tooLong: This is taking longer than expected.
differentiate.tooLongHint: The AI service may be busy or stopped. Your text isn’t lost: check again later or reuse it in a new request.
differentiate.reconnecting: Lost the connection to the server. Trying again…
differentiate.fixErrors: Some of the information isn’t valid. Fix the fields shown in red, then save again.
differentiate.draftOlder: This text was changed elsewhere after your last changes on this device, which weren’t saved. The most recent version is shown.
differentiate.savedWithoutLevels: Text saved. {count, plural, one {A level deleted in the meantime was left out.} other {# levels deleted in the meantime were left out.}}

levels.title: Language levels
levels.intro: Levels are used to differentiate texts and to group students. They are not an official Ministry or ALF scale.
levels.myLevelsHint: Levels of your own, on top of the board’s. Only you see them.
levels.label: Level name
levels.descriptionHint: Describe the expected language: sentence length, vocabulary, supports.
levels.deleteConfirm: Delete this level? Students who had it will no longer have a default level.
levels.empty: No levels of your own yet.
